name: plate-precheck
stage: after plate gates, before depth (tools/14-oneshot stage: plate sheet)

auto_checks.rule: plate is at native Imagine resolution (1024 long side for objects, 1280x720 per sky section); no upscale

auto_checks.fail: any patch >= 1% of plate area flat grey or near-black with no texture

auto_checks.rule: sky gate tools/10 incl. off-centre haze and diagonal star stripes
auto_checks.fail: any Milky Way band or stripe left in a sky still

auto_checks.rule: stars >= 2 px across at mip 0 and >= 0.97 of no-mip peak at mip 1
features that will be real geometry (icicles, cables, runes, cornices) must not also be painted into the plate outside their geometry footprint
adjacent sky sections and tiling ground plates join with no brightness step
palette and lighting match the zone key image (key-zd1-b.jpg for Zone D)
ice reads matte pale ice-blue, never chrome or white-clipped
auto_checks.fail: specular hot spots or clipped white on ice

auto_checks.rule: no hard-edged flat dark rectangles (stray shadow or floor planes)
auto_checks.fail: straight-edged near-black region with no texture

sheet: only plates passing auto_checks go on one contact sheet at 100% crops for Art Director KEEP/FAIL; depth starts only after KEEP
must_fail_fixtures: S09 final3 (diagonal stripe), S09 strong clean (blotchy)
terrace wall plate with painted icicles under geometric icicles
